name: LiquidAI/LFM3-Omni-2B
context_scaling: Card states 32K tokens input+output. The inheritance from LFM3-1.7B is visible in config.json text_config.max_position_embeddings = 128000, so the released omni checkpoint is served at 32K while the text stack was extended to 128K; take the card number as the usable window.
attention_variant: LFM3 text backbone plus LFM3 vision encoder and causal audio encoder: 13 gated short-convolution layers (conv), 5 sliding_attention layers (sliding_window 256) and 6 full_attention layers at indices 2,6,10,14,18,22; GQA 16 query / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128. Speech out via a depthformer and LiquidCodec (12 codebooks, 24 kHz).
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31 from the trending sweep. params_b 2.1669 = safetensors.total 2,166,928,384 (total incl. text, vision and audio encoders and the depthformer), not the 2.17B the card rounds to. kv_cache_bytes_per_token is 0 on the same basis used for LFM3-1.7B and LFM3-VL-2B: the six full-attention layers would cost 6 x 2 x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 B = 12,288 B/token if they held an unbounded per-token cache, but every attention layer sits behind a 256-token sliding window or a constant-state conv layer in this tri-hybrid stack, so the per-token cache is bounded and the field records 0 rather than the naive all-layers figure (24 layers would be 49,152 B/token). Non-reasoning model: enable_thinking is not supported. Licence is LFM Open License v1.0 (license: other), so it is open-weight but not OSI-open. Card publishes omni benchmarks; the rows recorded here are the ones where this 2.17B model beats larger neighbours, plus the rows it loses.

benchmarks.name: Daily-Omni
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Video + audio understanding', column 'LFM3-Omni2B'. Nearest published comparison in the catalog is MiniCPM-o 4.5 at 80.2 (8.7B) - this row LOSES to it. Vendors compared here: Qwen2.5-Omni3B 58.81, Qwen2.5-Omni7B 61.32, Gemma 4 E2B 50.63, Gemma 4 E4B 54.14, Phi-4-multimodal 48.87. Vendor run, harness not restated on the card.

benchmarks.name: WorldSense
benchmarks.config: Card row, column 'LFM3-Omni2B'. Catalog: MiniCPM-o 4.5 55.7, Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B 55.2, Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 54.0 - this row LOSES to all three larger omni models. Qwen2.5-Omni3B 44.99, Qwen2.5-Omni7B 45.37, Gemma 4 E2B 38.11, E4B 43.51, Phi-4-multimodal 42.37. Vendor run.

benchmarks.name: AV-SpeakerBench
benchmarks.config: Card row, column 'LFM3-Omni2B'; no catalog model publishes this benchmark yet, so the comparison is the card's own columns only (Qwen2.5-Omni3B 40.44, Qwen2.5-Omni7B 43.24, Gemma 4 E2B 32.32, E4B 36.36, Phi-4 37.95). Vendor run, harness not restated.

benchmarks.name: OmniBench (overall)
benchmarks.config: Card row 'OmniBench (overall)', column 'LFM3-Omni2B'. LOSES to Qwen2.5-Omni3B 47.11 and Qwen2.5-Omni7B 49.65; beats Phi-4-multimodal 38.97, Gemma 4 E2B 16.81 and E4B 20.67. Vendor run, harness not restated on the card.

benchmarks.name: RealWorldQA
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Spoken visual QA', column 'LFM3-Omni2B'. Catalog RealWorldQA rows are for vision-only models at different harnesses, so cross-family comparison is weak; the row is recorded as the card prints it. Qwen2.5-Omni3B 63.14, Gemma 4 E2B 48.63, E4B 53.07, Phi-4 64.84, Cosmos3Edge 72.81. Vendor run.

benchmarks.name: MMStar
benchmarks.config: Card table (second image table), column 'LFM3-Omni2B'. LOSES to Phi-4-multimodal 59.33 and Cosmos3Edge 56.07; beats Qwen2.5-Omni3B 55.67 (tie), Gemma 4 E2B 46.47, E4B 52.00. Vendor run.

benchmarks.name: MathVista (mini)
benchmarks.config: Card row, column 'LFM3-Omni2B'. Catalog LFM3-VL-2B (vision-only, same family) prints 84.2 on MathVista (mini); this omni model is 21.7 points lower on the same test name, so the omni multi-task training costs real vision-math accuracy. Phi-4-multimodal 65.40 beats it. Vendor run.

benchmarks.name: DocVQA
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Documents and OCR', column 'LFM3-Omni2B'. LOSES to Qwen2.5-Omni3B 92.71 and Phi-4-multimodal 92.60 by a hair; Gemma 4 E2B 73.49 and E4B 77.91 are far behind. Vendor run.

benchmarks.name: Tool calling (internal eval)
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Audio understanding / speech', row 'Tool calling internal eval'. LOSES to Gemma 4 E2B 55.60 and E4B 72.40; beats Qwen2.5-Omni3B 44.30. The benchmark is the vendor's own internal one, so it is not comparable to BFCL or tau2 rows elsewhere in the catalog.

benchmarks.name: English ASR WER
benchmarks.config: Card row 'English ASR WER ↓' (LOWER is better). Phi-4-multimodal 5.14 is better; Qwen2.5-Omni3B 6.30 is slightly better; Gemma 4 E2B 8.26 and E4B 7.82 are worse. Vendor run, harness not restated. Recorded with higher_is_better false.
